[SWS_DM_00863] Checking Supported Subfunction for RequestSeed
⌈
On
reception
of
a
request
for
UDS
Service
SecurityAccess
(0x27),
the
Diagnostic Server instance shall call diag::SecurityAccess::GetSeed
([SWS_DM_00764]) if the requested subfunction value (access type) matches
to the value of the instance of DiagnosticSecurityAccess with request-
SeedId.
The
security_access_data_record
parameter
of
the
method
diag::SecurityAccess::GetSeed ([SWS_DM_00764]) shall be filled with the
securityAccessDataRecord provided by the tester. If no data is provided by the
tester, the security_access_data_record parameter shall be empty.
⌋
